name: BACH_0259
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (100%)** · Confident · Read in turn

Single-class conformal set, second-model agreement and 5/5 Benign neighbors back it [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 100%; InSitu <1% | Strongly peaked |
| Conformal set | {Benign} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.999 / 100th pct | Unflagged; OOD percentile ambiguous |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 5 of 5 Benign | Unanimous |

## Tissue evidence
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 1, 5, 7) · ↓ invasive · Strongly associated with lower invasive likelihood · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 1, 4, 8) · ↓ invasive · Associated with lower invasive likelihood · Validated
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate** (regions 4, 5, 10) · context · Descriptive only; immune cell fraction high in sample · Weak
- **Nuclear size and shape variation** (regions 9, 10, 11) · context · Shape variation 100th percentile; mean nuclear size 5th · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit +0.54 versus random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI includes 0 (+0.002), so not shown to reflect the classifier. Mitoses and normal lobules are Unreliable (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Nuclear shape variation is 100th percentile; if atypia is real, Benign may be overconfident.
- Conformal coverage was checked on only 132 cases; the calibration error interval is wide.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 9, 11**: closest to the invasive direction on the heatmap; look for atypia or duct-confined cells.
2. **Regions 4, 5, 10**: model-flagged lymphocytes (8/20 spot check); confirm genuine TILs.
3. **Regions 1, 4, 8**: confirm tubules are benign glands.
